custody.assessment: Official Xinmi bureau functions assign natural-resource and real-estate registration and cadastral survey responsibilities. Its 2023 municipal notice proposes cadastral-map visual inquiry through Zhengzhou registration infrastructure, but does not establish anonymous vector access.

firstPartyChecks.observation: Official Xinmi bureau page identifies registration office, cadastral survey, and information-platform responsibilities.
Official municipal notice item 20 describes exploring visual cadastral-map inquiry through Zhengzhou system, without parcel API evidence.

decisionReason: No public Xinmi native-ID polygon response, schema or CRS, live adapter qualification, or headed Details check. Described visual inquiry does not prove open geometry.
